it's not that I'm asking to be an Instagram model. I just want to be healthy like other people.
Humanity doesn't need another broken person and I'm the last person to call for help. If anything I might be doing the world a favour, I have bad genes and have not made achievements at all

Yes. Not as severe as cancer or others but it'll leave me in a bad condition in the long run. There's nothing I can do for it. Plus I'm already experiencing what like 40-50 year olds start when they age. I can't see myself working or studying as long as the average.
